scope.scientific_question: Resolution-only ablation of completed E1: global WH 896x384 to 1344x576; all other frozen scientific controls unchanged

forbidden: E1 validator bypass or contract mutation

data.label_id_definition: Index in the immutable labels.json ordered list, 0 through 123

image_access.test: metadata_only; reject every test image access before opening files throughout all E1-HR stages
image_access.invalid_samples: fail and record; never skip or replace
image_access.path_policy: Resolve manifest-relative paths inside configured dataset root; reject escapes and label mismatches

audit.policy: Current full 34997-train/7497-val byte-hash and containment audit plus preprocessing conformance for actual root/packages before model allocation; dataset remains immutable; archived pilot or E1 acceptance alone cannot satisfy HR acceptance. Refresh integrity in official preflight and repeat conformance when root/content/packages change.

preprocessing.geometry_ui_and_resize_authority: Use unchanged frozen config/module; no duplicate coordinate tables, weights.transforms(), preview inputs, EXIF transposition, uint8 requantization, post-resize hard remasking or alternative backend. Only global target WH changes.

arithmetic.letterbox: scale=min(target_w/source_w,target_h/source_h); content_w=min(target_w,max(1,floor(source_w*scale+0.5))); content_h analogously; left=(target_w-content_w)//2, top=(target_h-content_h)//2; remainder right/bottom; pad after resize; normalize last

augmentation.application: Frozen valid-scene photometric formulas before UI mean fill; brightness before contrast; preserve masks/padding

photometric_formulas.scope: Valid scene pixels after footer crop, before UI mean fill; UI excluded from statistics
photometric_formulas.contrast: gray_mean = mean(sum(brightness_adjusted_scene * grayscale_weights, channel), valid_pixels); clamp(c*image+(1-c)*gray_mean,0,1)
photometric_formulas.fill: Fill UI with exact ImageNet float32 mean after photometric changes; preserve padding

preprocessing.global_source: Decoded raw image through the frozen preprocessor; never upscale an E1 image or canvas

model.stochastic_depth_schedule: TorchVision 0.23.0 block-index linear schedule from 0 to 0.1

pretrained.verification: Require exact filename, existence, and full digest before strict state loading
pretrained.starting_state: Fresh pinned ImageNet weights for every HR tuning trial and final seed; fresh optimizer/scheduler; no E1, pilot, other-trial or selected-tuning checkpoint warm-start

selection.reference: Global maximum M over all four valid completed trial selected-checkpoint scores
selection.selected_lr_policy: Derived only from all four valid full-budget HR trials; unknown until locked HR selection; no selected numeric LR is serialized in this draft

failure_policy.operational_interruption: Retain attempt records and resume the same immutable declared run from its own last.pt at boundary zero or a completed epoch, replaying an uncommitted epoch from its beginning without changing budget
failure_policy.invalid_or_uncompletable_candidate: Stop and return for explicit user review; do not ignore, replace, or select from a subset
failure_policy.records: Retain all failures, interruptions, replays, and any reviewed retries with identity/lineage; no silent fresh replacement

stage_authorization.tuning: Explicit HR-G3a only after HR-G1, actual HR target acceptance and HR-G2
stage_authorization.post_selection: STOP and hand off complete tuning ledger, all four outcomes and locked HR selection for user review
stage_authorization.final: Separate explicit HR-G3b after tuning handoff; binds HR-G2, selected-LR bytes and three fresh final declarations

batch.train_sampling: Natural shuffled permutation without replacement; every unique train image exactly once per completed epoch
batch.validation_sampling: All validation images in fixed manifest order, no shuffle or augmentation
batch.accumulation_loss: For each accumulation group with D actual original images, sum unweighted CE and divide by D, including all short tails; one optimizer/scheduler update per completed group

loss.name: standard_unweighted_cross_entropy
loss.loss_reporting: Sample means over all split images, never unweighted averages of batch means

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.group_validation: Enumerate actual parameter names; every trainable tensor appears exactly once; fail unexpected categories, duplicates or omissions; all groups share candidate base LR and schedule
optimizer.numerical_failure: Nonfinite logits/loss/unscaled gradients or OOM fails and is recorded; no silent batch/update skip or LR/batch/resolution/runtime substitution

budget.success: Exactly eight completed training epochs and eight complete validations; never a shortened successful run

scheduler.name: linear_warmup_then_update_cosine
scheduler.update_index: u is the zero-based optimizer update being executed, 0 <= u < N; L is the candidate base LR, W=1000, N=139992, f=1e-6
scheduler.application: Apply LR(u) before optimizer update u; advance completed-update state only after the update; validation does not advance scheduler

endpoints.final_floor_equality: Exact at final update; no remaining scheduler update is executed afterward

scheduler.restoration: Restore the same completed-update position and immutable full horizon/parameters; do not reset warmup or change horizon based on selected checkpoint; reject over-budget updates

initialization.seed: official training seed for this run
initialization.rng_context: Isolated CPU RNG context immediately around initialization; restore outer CPU RNG afterward

derived_seed.encoding: UTF-8 of pipe-separated str values: str(training_seed) followed by each key part, joined with |

epoch_order.generator: Fresh CPU torch.Generator seeded with derived_seed; torch.randperm(dataset_length)
epoch_order.persistent_workers: Carry epoch with every sampled index; never depend on a mutable parent-only epoch

augmentation.generator: Fresh CPU torch.Generator seeded with derived_seed
augmentation.draws: Two sequential torch.rand scalar draws, brightness then contrast, each mapped by 1-amplitude+2*amplitude*draw

loaders.generator: Separate CPU torch.Generator per split; state saved/restored
loaders.worker_python_numpy_seed: torch.initial_seed() % 2**32; seed Python and NumPy in worker initialization; torch worker seed comes from DataLoader generator

rng.process_start: Export PYTHONHASHSEED=str(official_run_seed) before every Python process, including declaration checks; never copy pilot 3406
checkpoint_state: train and validation loader generator states
rng.partial_epoch: Discard uncommitted epoch; restore previous committed last.pt and replay that epoch from its beginning; replay is operational work and never extra completed budget
rng.persistent_worker_resume: Reconstruct fresh workers using original bootstrap state while restoring/preserving committed logical loader generator state; restarting workers must not consume an additional logical loader draw versus uninterrupted persistent workers

environment.PYTHONHASHSEED: str(official_training_seed), exported before Python process startup

runtime.tf32_environment_overrides: Reject any effective environment override that enables TF32; record actual effective Torch settings, not requested values alone
runtime.execution_identity: Acceptance and official runs compare identity.scientific_runtime: reviewed consumed-source file hashes/fingerprint, HR contract, software/effective runtime/device/driver/allocation policy and current data/preprocessing/pretrained/conformance bindings. Record the actual clean Git commit, cleanliness, acceptance/test inventories and job/MIG identifiers separately as audit metadata, not scientific equality keys. A docs-only or test-only clean commit after acceptance does not invalidate unchanged scientific/runtime identity. Any consumed runtime/scientific file change requires renewed target acceptance; runtime/input mismatches cannot silently proceed. Immutable config, receipt and checkpoint checks remain mandatory.
runtime.pilot_driver_reference: 580.126.20; historical supporting evidence, not an unconditional exact-driver lock
runtime.local_validation: Draft preparation performs document/contract checks only. Future synthetic CPU fixtures are never official HR or UIT evidence.

deployment.gpu_work: UIT Slurm only, after explicit HR stage-specific authorization; HR-G1 implementation approval grants no target work

required_actual_identity: Explicit reviewed scientific/runtime consumed-file map and canonical fingerprint
target_acceptance.before_model_allocation: Full train/val byte-hash integrity, containment and frozen preprocessing conformance for actual root/packages, including HR input construction
target_acceptance.probe_scope: Bounded discard/reconstruct/restore/replay on accepted deterministic stack; test-only mechanics boundary cannot count as an official completed epoch or campaign outcome; CPU integration separately checks full-epoch control flow
required_audit_metadata: actual clean Git commit and cleanliness observation
exact acceptance/test harness path, byte length and SHA-256 inventory
actual job/allocation identifiers and MIG UUID when available
target_acceptance.identity_equality: Reviewed identity.scientific_runtime projection only; clean Git commit and acceptance/test inventory are separate audit metadata. Different docs/test-only clean commits remain eligible when consumed hashes and all other scientific/runtime bindings match; any consumed-file change requires renewed target acceptance.

deployment.walltime_resume: 09:00:00 limits one job attempt, not the run; one run may span attempts; never assume eight HR epochs finish in one allocation, reset warmup, change horizon or extend completed budget
deployment.path_adoption: HR roots are implementation-design choices submitted for HR-G1 approval; separate from E1 and pilot. Dataset/pretrained/Python paths inherit reviewed UIT references. No directory or job exists by virtue of this draft.

checkpoint.rule: Select first completed epoch initially; replace only when current_metric - selected_metric > tau, where tau = 1e-6; retain earlier checkpoint otherwise; NLL cannot break ties

roles.last.pt: Atomic full-state committed boundary for same-run resume; never resume from best.pt

checkpoint.boundaries: Boundary zero and completed-epoch boundaries only. An epoch is committed after its full training and full validation, with counters/history/selection and full state atomically in last.pt. No partial/minibatch training commit. An attempt terminating during an epoch discards it and replays it from its beginning from the previous committed last.pt.
checkpoint.identity: Explicit E1-HR experiment/resolution/stage/seed/LR/original budget, HR config/contract hashes, fixed data/preprocessing/pretrained fingerprints and accepted identity.scientific_runtime projection. Compare reviewed consumed-source fingerprint and runtime bindings, not audit Git commit or acceptance/test inventory; record each clean commit/inventory separately. Reject all E1/pilot kinds, cross-run config mismatches and changed consumed source/runtime; a consumed-file change requires renewed target acceptance.
checkpoint.safety: Atomic replacement and one writer per immutable run directory; failed writes retain prior committed boundary; no overwrite with a new trial
checkpoint.reports: Every per-run metric uses the same selected HR checkpoint even if last.pt is later. Final initialization is fresh ImageNet, never selected tuning/E1/pilot state.
checkpoint.publication_recovery: last.pt is authoritative and carries selected_weights plus selection/history; reconstruct derived best.pt/history after interrupted publication without advancing training beyond the committed boundary or epoch eight

reporting.ranking: Descending original logits; exactly tied logits ordered by ascending label_id; never alter logits
reporting.macro_f1: Average full-split per-class F1 over GT-supported classes only
reporting.unsupported_f1: null; excluded from supported macro average
reporting.weighted_f1: Weight full-split per-class F1 by evaluation GT support
reporting.bucket_f1: Average supported bucket member per-class F1 computed on entire evaluation split, retaining cross-bucket false positives
reporting.bucket_topk: GT-conditioned bucket samples ranked across all 124 outputs; no-support bucket metrics are null
reporting.machine_precision: Preserve full floating-point values in JSON/CSV; do not round before aggregate calculations

human_display.std: Same percentage units and four decimals as mean

reporting.pilot_metrics: Diagnostic only; no official score acceptance threshold or evidence substitution
reporting.final_test_access: LOCKED / NOT AUTHORIZED throughout HR specification, implementation, acceptance, tuning, finals, validation reporting and closeout; no test evaluator
reporting.final_evaluation_gate: Only after all intended comparison experiments, including E3 if retained, freeze protocols/checkpoints and close intended training/validation work, followed by separate explicit user approval; no HR gate or closeout substitutes

comparison.policy: Read-only comparison against E1 three-seed aggregate; never pilot or best E1 seed. Verify same benchmark, metric definitions, three seed IDs and ddof=1. Preserve source-file digest.
comparison.paired_deltas: Optional matching-seed E1-versus-HR deltas; three seeds alone do not establish significance

limitations: Fixed split does not establish geographic/panorama independence
Three-seed variation does not eliminate seed/sampling uncertainty or establish significance

provenance.numeric_authority: Approved docs/E1-HR/specs.md plus explicit user HR-G0 confirmation and the requested wording clarifications; inherited values are settled requirements, not proposals
provenance.snapshot_semantics: Source document/reference hashes below identify preparation inputs, not future accepted HR scientific/runtime identity. The scientific/runtime consumed-file fingerprint is separate from docs and acceptance/test audit inventories. Later docs/test-only clean commits do not invalidate unchanged accepted consumed-source/runtime identity. No plan/ledger update requires mutating frozen contract bytes after approval. This JSON never embeds its own digest.

source_evidence.role: Direct approved HR scientific authority; includes two minor clarifications requested after HR-G0
Completed E1 comparator/methodology and evidence-scope reference
Bounded unchanged numerical mechanics reuse reference
Bounded unchanged full-split metrics reuse reference
Diagnostic HR feasibility declaration, never official HR approval
Diagnostic train-only timing/feasibility, never official HR result
Historical timing/history supporting multi-attempt planning, no scientific adoption decision
Historical diagnostic completion, not HR acceptance
Official read-only E1 comparator, not an HR output

numeric_value_rationales.resolution: HR spec Sections 1/3: accepted 1344x576; direct frozen raw preprocessing; only input-policy change
numeric_value_rationales.data_model_loss_optimizer_init_rng_runti: HR spec Sections 2-4 explicitly inherit exact completed E1 controls; no re-adoption or search
numeric_value_rationales.grid_seeds_checkpoint_lr_selection: HR spec Sections 2/5; independent HR four-trial campaign and mandatory STOP before separately authorized finals
numeric_value_rationales.attempt_resume_acceptance: HR spec Section 6 and user clarification: completed-epoch commits, full uncommitted-epoch replay, per-attempt nine-hour limit and HR-specific real-target acceptance
numeric_value_rationales.identity: HR spec Section 7; separate HR package/kinds/roots/receipts; design choices submitted for HR-G1
numeric_value_rationales.reporting_and_test_gate: HR spec Sections 8/9; ddof=1/full precision; official E1 aggregate comparator and study-wide final-test gate including E3 if retained
numeric_value_rationales.control_review_trigger: User post-HR-G0 clarification: material target-acceptance failure preventing correct frozen-protocol execution only; minor operations do not reopen science

approval_snapshot_at_preparation.snapshot_role: Historical preparation status; no receipt or execution authorization
approval_snapshot_at_preparation.HR-G0: PASS; explicit user confirmation in current session
approval_snapshot_at_preparation.implementation_method: User selects at HR-G1; not a scientific numeric field
approval_snapshot_at_preparation.approval_binding: HR-G1 must explicitly approve the exact JSON bytes by SHA-256, external checksum sidecar, plan/ledger and implementation method; draft parsing or hashing grants no approval

checksum_policy.sidecar_format: <64 lowercase hex>  e1hr_numeric_contract_v1.json followed by LF
checksum_policy.sidecar_creation: At explicit HR-G1 freeze; not created during draft preparation

scientific_control_change_policy.review_trigger: Only a material HR target-acceptance failure that prevents the frozen E1-HR protocol from being executed correctly may trigger explicit user review of inherited controls

attempts.partial_epoch_policy: Restore the previous committed last.pt and replay the entire uncommitted epoch from its beginning; discard partial work
attempts.budget: Original eight epochs/eight full validations/139992 completed optimizer updates across all attempts; replays never count twice
records: observed replay work with timing scope
unknown uncommitted work explicitly marked unknown
attempts.retry_policy: Review recorded outcome and preserve same declaration/identity/budget; no automatic resubmission or longer walltime choice
attempts.scientific_control_review: Minor operational failures do not reopen controls; only material target-acceptance inability to execute the frozen protocol correctly may trigger explicit user review

identity_and_evidence.source_record: Record exact repository-relative consumed-file SHA-256 map and its canonical fingerprint in identity.scientific_runtime. Record each actual clean Git commit/cleanliness and exact acceptance/test inventory in audit metadata, at acceptance and every official attempt; never impose Git-commit equality on scientific identity. Preparation-reference hashes do not assert future HR acceptance.
identity_and_evidence.canonical_fingerprint: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False); distinct from exact-byte file SHA-256

receipts.HR-G1: Exact HR contract bytes/sidecar, written plan/ledger, implementation method and explicit implementation permission
receipts.target_work: Explicit HR GPU acceptance authorization before HR-T11
receipts.HR-G2: Approved identity.scientific_runtime/device and acceptance evidence digest; retain clean acceptance Git commit and exact harness/evidence inventory separately as audit metadata. Later clean docs/test-only commits do not invalidate unchanged consumed-source/runtime identity.
receipts.HR-G3a: HR-G2 receipt SHA-256 and exactly four authorized HR tuning run IDs
receipts.HR-G3b: HR-G2 receipt SHA-256, exact locked-selection SHA-256 and exactly three authorized HR final run IDs

preserved_artifacts: all four trial outcomes and failures/retries
identity_and_evidence.lineage_validation: declaration <-> resolved config <-> summary <-> complete history <-> selected checkpoint <-> locked selection <-> analyses <-> aggregate/report; reject wrong experiment/resolution/stage/seed/LR/budget/consumed-source/runtime/fingerprints. Compare scientific_runtime projections across acceptance/runs/resume/campaign; audit commit/tooling inventory differences alone do not fail scientific identity. Preserve all audit records and exact config/receipt/evidence/checkpoint checks.
identity_and_evidence.report_binding_policy: Per-run reports carry stage/seed/lr/budget and common identity explicitly; aggregates carry stage=final, all three per_seed identities and shared LR/budget/accepted identity, with each selected checkpoint/history/declaration binding retained. Acceptance is a distinct nonofficial evidence stage, never a tuning/final outcome.

source_fingerprint_policy.definition: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the explicit repository-relative path -> exact-byte SHA-256 map, using canonical_fingerprint serialization
source_fingerprint_policy.package_markers: Normal src.e1.engine/src.e1.metrics and preprocessing imports execute the listed src, src.e1hr, src.e1 and src.preprocessing package markers; include their exact bytes
source_fingerprint_policy.actual_import_review: Verify actual transitive runtime imports at implementation/acceptance; missing listed files fail. Explicitly add any additional consumed repository file to the reviewed closure before acceptance; never silently omit it.
source_fingerprint_policy.reporting_only_source: src/e1hr/report.py is hashed in reporting audit inventory, outside the training closure unless actually imported by the training path
source_fingerprint_policy.separate_integrity_bindings: The frozen HR contract, dataset/label files, pretrained weights, accepted conformance/acceptance evidence and stage receipts retain their independent exact-hash checks; exclusion from this source map does not waive them

acceptance_test_evidence_inventory.role: Exact-hash audit inventory, separate from the scientific/runtime fingerprint; capture actual files when implemented, never fabricate hashes for nonexistent files
acceptance_test_evidence_inventory.additional_files: Enumerate every actually consumed acceptance-only helper and each acceptance evidence/output by exact path; do not use this inventory as a training source closure
acceptance_test_evidence_inventory.snapshot_policy: Preserve immutable inventory/evidence for each acceptance attempt; later edits do not rewrite earlier proof
acceptance_test_evidence_inventory.proof_validity_policy: A test-only correction affecting validity of an acceptance proof requires evidence review; unrelated test edits do not automatically invalidate accepted scientific/runtime identity

separate_mandatory_lineage_checks: HR-G2 receipt and accepted evidence exact hashes
scientific_identity_equality.clean_git_requirement: Require and record an actual clean checkout at acceptance and each official attempt; cleanliness is mandatory, but the commit SHA need not match acceptance
scientific_identity_equality.unchanged_identity_condition: Every consumed-file hash and all other reviewed scientific/runtime bindings must remain equal; full config, receipts and evidence still validate
scientific_identity_equality.consumed_file_change: Reject before model allocation and require renewed target acceptance; no scientific control is changed by this policy

pending_design_review: HR-G1 approval/freeze of exact candidate bytes and external sidecar
HR package/schema and separate root adoption as proposed in plan
later_required_observations_or_outputs: current actual-root integrity/conformance and HR acceptance results
HR selected LR and full tuning ledger
input_completeness.later_outputs_policy: Do not serialize invented values or numeric defaults for these outputs; collect them only at the authorized stage

record_semantics: All settings, expected counts and zero-test-access values are requirements, not observed HR execution results. Preparation hashes identify existing input/reference files only. This draft grants no execution authorization.
